info.title: Partner Growth Copilot API
info.description: Secured REST API custom extension for IBM watsonx Assistant to generate IBM-centric solution proposals using IBM watsonx.ai runtime models.

servers.description: IBM Cloud Code Engine Production URL

post.description: Accepts deal context input from watsonx Assistant or client application, queries IBM watsonx.ai Granite/Llama models, and returns a structured solution proposal.

raw_input.description: Customer and deal context details captured by watsonx Assistant (max 8000 chars).
raw_input.example: Customer: Acme Retail; Industry: retail; Use case: AI analytics; Budget: 100k; Timeline: Q4.

proposal.description: Generated multi-paragraph IBM-centric solution proposal text.
proposal.example:
### Overview
Acme Retail can leverage IBM watsonx to optimize AI analytics...

### Architecture summary
Integration of watsonx.data with watsonx.ai for real-time analytics...

### Key IBM components
- IBM watsonx.ai
- IBM watsonx Orchestrate
- IBM Cloud Pak for Data

### Business benefits
Accelerated decision-making and reduced compute costs...

### Next steps
Schedule initial architecture design session with IBM channel technical lead.

400.description: Bad Request - Missing, non-string, or overly long raw_input field

error.example: raw_input is required and must be a reasonable-length string

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid X-PGC-KEY header

500.description: Internal Server Error - Failed to generate proposal via watsonx.ai

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-PGC-KEY
ApiKeyAuth.description: API Key authentication header matching PGC_API_KEY environment variable
